name: Conway
source:
Conway puts you in the shoes of a newly recruited sailor on a late 18th-century merchant vessel. Drawn in by ideas of adventure and freedom that you couldn't find in the town you grew up in. The long voyages between ports leave plenty of time to get to know others on the ship with you and perhaps figure out how this newfound freedom will look for you.

[From [url=https://nomaxart.itch.io/conway]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Conway》中，你将扮演18世纪末一艘商船上新招募的水手。你向往冒险与自由，而这些是成长的小镇无法给予你的，于是，你登上了这艘船。港口之间漫长的航程，留给你充足的时间去了解同船的伙伴，或许也能让你弄清，这份新获得的自由，对你而言究竟意味着什么。

[摘自[url=https://nomaxart.itch.io/conway]Itch.io[/url]]
